title: Nine Teaching Effects Give Lesson Cards Their Own Look | vitalii.no
description:
My kids' lesson cards had no visual engine of their own. Any new lesson had to borrow animation from a news-digest motion library, built for grown-up fact-checking graphics, not for the teach-and-reveal moments a real lesson actually needs, like swapping a wrong answer for a right one or sorting items into bins.

I built a dedicated lesson-video project with its own effects catalog and nine teaching effects, among them a magnifier zoom, a reveal-the-answer moment, and a sort-into-bins effect, plus a skill file that tells the writer which effect fits which teaching moment. Each lesson card now renders from a plain data file, validated first, then rendered into a grid of frames for review, with the first real sample covering an environmental-toxins lesson.

Lesson cards now render through a motion system built specifically for teaching, with nine dedicated effects instead of a borrowed library that was never meant for a kid's lesson.
